requests.question: On Wednesday morning the following conversation took place:A man: "My stereo speakers haven't been sounding good lately. The owner of a stereo store promised to give me $15 for them, and I think I'll take him up on the offer. "A woman: "Don't do that. In my spare time, I repair stereo speakers. If you promise to pay me $20, I promise to repair them by next Tuesday and they'll be in tip-top condition. "The man then handed his speakers and $20 to the woman. The conversation and events on Wednesday resulted in
choices: a contract for the sale of services governed by the UCC.
requests.subject: professional_law
